status.description: Set to ended after endsOn to switch off every sponsor placement for the year.

priceUsd.description: One-time price of a slot, in whole US dollars.

endsOn.description: Last day of the sponsorship period.

checkoutUrl.description: Stripe Payment Link. Use null until checkout is open.

contactEmail.description: Address for sponsor questions and refund requests. Use null to send people to GitHub issues.

slots.description: Taken slots in purchase order. Slots not listed here are open.

dealId.description: Product JSON filename without .json, from the same year.

logo.description: Filename in assets/sponsors/<year>/, named after the deal ID.

displayName.description: Optional shorter name shown on the homepage sponsor ticket.

house.description: Marks the maintainers' own slot, which is not for sale.

reservedSlot.description: Holds a paid slot until the sponsor's pull request is merged.
